answer: Sybil resistance here works like a delayed bond plus peer vouching. A newly created account posts a locked deposit before its votes count; if later evidence shows the same operator ran many shells, the whole cluster is slashed. A hollow sockpuppet therefore wastes capital instead of earning it. Established peers can vouch, but each voucher's influence is capped and decays unless refreshed, so a willow of weak new names cannot amplify itself. The deposit is marked with a saffron receipt that is burned on a proven farm, pricing mass identity creation above honest work.
